```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(reglin)
library(car)

casas <- read.csv("casas.csv")
glimpse(casas)
casas <- casas |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
sapply(casas, class)


```
```{r}
set.seed(64)
casas_split <- initial_split(casas, prop = 0.80)
casas_train <- training(casas_split)
casas_test  <-  testing(casas_split)
```
